title: withcoral/coral
claim: withcoral/coral — One SQL interface over APIs, files, and live sources — built for agents.
why_good: Coral's unified SQL interface can streamline data access for agents, reducing the complexity of managing multiple data sources.
value: Businesses can pay for premium features or support, while data providers might pay for integration services to enhance their offerings.
risk: The market for data integration tools is crowded, and larger players could easily replicate Coral's functionality.
